notes: «هو عبد الرحمن بن ثابت بن ثوبان» is an identification gloss and is left out (rule 1); the link is ابن ثوبان as written
The second isnad after the matn ends «نحوه» (like it): same saying, so it is a second group, and each branch writes its own names so the tail is null (rule 3)
«قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن صحيح» is commentary and is left out
